title: ArcEvents Apocalypse source workbenches: item-cost progression, finite shared inputs and isolated XP (2026-11-15)
assumptions: Source-level before/after assessment for the weapon-workbench addition after source loot 0.6.2; not proof of publication, delivery, activation, native client appearance or ordinary-player completion.

Before these source workbench recipes are unavailable, not free. After:107catalog rows:66gun(12T1,37T2,17T3),21ammo,6station(T1/T2/T3/AMMO/PRESS/REFINERY),14material(3ammo_box+3press+shaft+2casing+refinerycasing+fuelbatch+3alloys), plus separate native tungsten blasting. Attachments,colorizers and unsupported source rows are not craftable in this scope.

Low/base/high are conditional stocked-inventory sensitivities, not telemetry or sustainable production: 1/5/20 participating accounts;1/2/4 active hours per participant-day. All modeled participants have the required existing station and inputs; overall server participation share is unknown.

Within those same assumed hours, each participant crafts1/4/16 batches of source9mm ammo,0/1/2DB-2guns, presses4/16/64iron,1/4/16gold and0/4/16industrial iron ingots, blasts0/5/20raw tungsten, and performs0/1/4of EACH of the3refinery alloy recipes. Existing stations,all ingredients and stored cell energy are assumed available. These simultaneous operations share the stated hours; no jobs/contracts income is stacked.

Crafting occurs only after complete current station/item/count/output-capacity validation. Output quantities in this model assume an admitted successful operation. Failed, cancelled, stale, insufficient-input and overflowing operations must produce no output and consume no ingredients; reload/replay and rapid repeated clicks require focused runtime checks.

Items use separately named produced or consumed item units, with kind=item and positive quantities in by_kind.item; they are never added into money supply. Native furnace XP has its own player_xp_expedition unit. Currency totals apply only to separately reported Vault and premium tokens.

All recipe guns omit GunCurrentAmmoCount and start loaded=0. Source ammo identities are retained, but the current Paper firearm adapter accepts common native ammunition across calibers; native gun behavior remains the existing10 profiles. Source cost fidelity is not equal combat utility or full mod mechanics.

Mod materials require source PDC identities; ordinary carrier iron/gold/etc cannot satisfy a mod component ingredient. Old untagged loot is not retroactively converted because its original identity is unrecoverable. Plain vanilla items still satisfy genuine vanilla ingredient rows.

The93 source loot tables, rolls, weights, quantities, empty outcomes and finite shared claim policy stay unchanged. Near-city additional container accessibility and permitted administrator flight may change time to reach eligible containers, but neither exploration speed nor opening/table mix is measured or reweighted here.

Shared physical containers are finite once per coordinate, not per viewer/day. Source ore blocks are finite world stock, not replenishing rewards. Seven-day scenario multiplication requires sufficient distinct unclaimed inputs or new exploration; it does not assert a global weekly cap, renewal or guaranteed multi-account supply.

Pinned source processing: iron/gold/industrial-iron pressing is1 input->1 matching sheet. The press is found or crafted from1shaft+1andesite_casing+1iron_block;2andesite_alloy->8shaft, and1stripped log/wood+1andesite_alloy->1casing. Casing item_application is adapted to CRAFTING with unchanged quantities. Raw tungsten blasting is1->1,240ticks,2native furnace XP per extracted processed item and normal native fuel. Source ore mining gives0XP. No extra workbench/press XP is assigned; fuel is not zero or monetized.

A complete example route builds T1,T2,T3,AMMO and one DB-2,AKM,AF-46, plus one iron ammo box. It is a representative material bill, not a mandatory all66-gun purchase or measured time to accumulate. A newly crafted press setup is itemized separately from an already owned/found press, with7shaft remainder; native blast-furnace setup,fuel and tool remain separate non-free prerequisites.

Inventory,armor,offhand and XP remain in the isolated expedition profile; origin state is restored on exit. External shop/contract commands and export are blocked by the existing boundary. Other plugins reward hooks require HOST integration/ledger observation; source checks cannot prove their absence.

No new money price,payout,boost or token purchase: direct Vault mint/burn=0 and premium-token mint/burn=0 independently before/after. No fictional item exchange rate, SELL valuation, savings income or accumulation time is assigned. Existing SELL/BUY policy and the planned SELL-to-contract transition are unchanged.

Current tool metadata exposes no economy or arc_ops_server tool. A fresh168-hour ledger could not be obtained in this session; no shell/API bypass was used. Prior dated ledger observations, if consulted elsewhere, are not evidence for this version or ordinary workbench throughput.

Native refinery is explicitly adapted: one crafted source control-pad item represents the full original1pad+9bottomcasing+8pressuretank+5casing multiblock. The pad retains its own source material cost; the omitted formation lowers reusable capital requirements. Source80/100/150second refining waits and superheated mixer requirement are not enforced. Manufacturing uses the existing atomic instant menu, not full Create simulation.

Exact refinery ratios:1titanium+1rhenium+320energy->1TiRalloy+2void_slag;2tungsten+1rhenium+400energy->1WRalloy+2slag;1netherite+1rhenium+600energy->1NRalloy+4slag. Refining grants0XP. Original recipes/bytecode are pinned to Depths file8145376 and archive SHA256d20a72131f49c91d03ab709ac7f08451d95ccf84d637389ed0a6629b0ef68f08.

One source fuel cell stores1000units. Native fuel batch uses10blazerods+10coalblocks+10typed powderedup:sulfur_dust+1lava bucket->10cells+1empty bucket:exact100mB lava per cell. The empty bucket returns the existing container shell, not a free new bucket. No ordinary gunpowder substitution or free fuel is assumed.

Full cells stack with1000units each; partial cells are portable maxStack1 items storing1..999units. Spending uses partials first; cells at0are removed. Any alloy,slag or partial-cell output capacity failure refuses the full operation without input/energy debit. Per-recipe energy is consumed exactly, not rounded to a whole cell; reload/duplicate checks remain runtime obligations.

The3alloy acquisition routes replace the earlier13-T3 missing-refinery limitation at source/schema level. All17T3recipes retain positive ingredient costs; source graph support does not prove remaining live input stocks, fuel availability or ordinary-player completion. HAR50alone uses the owner-approved registered netherite_rhenium_alloy alias at unchanged count2.

Each awarded count applies its own Fortune ore_drops multiplier. BeforeFortune cohort EV=76.5rawiron+25.5rhenium; FortuneIII EV=168.3rawiron+56.1rhenium, maxima408/204. The separate14rhenium from studied chests is unchanged and not a new grant.

Mining adapters replace old native carrier drops at exact source coordinates: tungsten_ore previously mapped to deepslate_iron_ore, columbite to polished_deepslate. New typed-output availability is not a claim old world-material yield was0. Native rawiron processing and consequent XP remain unchanged recipes, but their realized extra throughput/XP is unmeasured and is not asserted0 by the modeled tungsten-XP row.
Station display cosmetics grant0inventory items,0fuel,0XP and0boost. Representation is not evidence of manufacturing or visual acceptance.

Native anti-arbitrage substitution: refinery casing uses IRON_INGOT carrier, not IRON_BLOCK. Source6iron+3bars->2casings must not become18plain iron by uncrafting2native iron blocks. Ingot carriers yield at most2ordinary iron-equivalent frommore than6inputs; original2casing count/sourcePDC stay intact. No general vanilla crafting gate is added or claimed; sacrificing source identity through native carrier use is not free component reconstruction.
